ev-8776edbd03.rationale: Combined component review, consistency only, not a provider rule. The synthetic line contains five bare GitHub prefixes and bare GitLab, npm, SendGrid and Slack prefixes; every credential body is absent. Five component claims are separately supported: (1) the GitHub prefix group by pinned gitleaks and TruffleHog artifacts requiring a nonempty body, (2) glpat- by their respective GitLab artifacts, (3) npm_ by their respective npm artifacts, (4) xoxb- by gitleaks and Nosey Parker artifacts requiring a numeric first section, and (5) SG. by the SendGrid statement that issued API keys are 69 characters, whereas the bare prefix has three. Each component claim cites at most two sources. The combined entry uses tool-corroborated, the least strong basis among its components; the SendGrid component alone is provider-documented. No fixed provider length is asserted for GitHub installation tokens. The component absence is directly repeatable from the fixture bytes; no scanner was executed, and no scanner output or majority is evidence. Distinct organizations and different repositories are observed; independent authorship beyond that is a reviewer check. Slack short-section dissent from the earlier review does not assert that a bodyless prefix is a credential.
